title: Arabic dialect
question: Which variety of Arabic is this text written in?

choices.msa: Modern Standard Arabic (fusha): formal, written, news or official register
choices.levantine: Levantine Arabic: Lebanese, Syrian, Palestinian, Jordanian
choices.gulf: Gulf Arabic: Saudi, Emirati, Kuwaiti, Qatari, Bahraini, Omani
choices.maghrebi: Maghrebi Arabic: Moroccan, Algerian, Tunisian, Libyan

rubric: Five-way coarse dialect ID, the level at which docs/arabic-model-experiment-2026-09-14.md found the real differences between models (Levantine to MSA: Gemma 94.2 chrF, Qwen3 61.0). Most items carry one or more textbook markers (e.g. Egyptian عايز/دلوقتي/إزيك, Levantine شو/هلق/بدي/كتير, Gulf شلونك/أبغى/وايد/الحين, Maghrebi واش/بزاف/دابا/برشا). The last item of each class is harder: short, or with a single marker.
labeller: Hand-written and hand-labelled by the Claude Opus 5.5 session running brief 05. Not reviewed by a native speaker of every dialect; treat single-item disagreements with that in mind.
